items.headline: Sesko suffers recurring shin injury, ruled out of Slovenia duty
items.summary: Benjamin Sesko withdrawn from Slovenia squad after recurring shin injury. Will undergo tests this week to determine recovery plan. Previously sidelined in May and missed all pre-season.

items.headline: Man Utd considers Serhou Guirassy move amid Sesko fitness concerns
items.summary: Manchester United assessing January reinforcements for attack. Borussia Dortmund striker Guirassy under consideration following Sesko's recurring injury issues this season.
